devon: Seeing a regression on Mixtral-large p95 when context > ~8k. Started after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Baseline p50 ~45ms, p95 jumped to ~220ms for some traces.

maria: Any clustering by batch size or concurrency?

devon: Mostly small batches (1-4) but many concurrent single-user streams. Kernel selector seems to flip to a fallback GEMM kernel around step=1024 and we pay a large switch cost + KV eviction churn.

navid: Can you paste the profiler snapshot you grabbed?

devon: attaching quick snippet from perf capture: ```
CPU: kernel_selector.cpp:select_kernel()
hotpath: 68% time spent in kernel_switch + memcpy(kv->evict)
GPU: fused_attn path shows 3x lower tail than fallback_gemm for seq>2048
p50 throughput: baseline 800 tok/s -> after change 760 tok/s (small)
p95 latency: baseline 180ms -> after change 220ms (large)
conclusion: switch overhead + KV eviction thrash when mixed short/long ctxs
```

maria: do we have a quick repro?

devon: repro script: ```bash
# reproducer for long-seq tail
python tools/bench.py --model mixtral-large --seq 12288 --batch 1 --concurrency 6 --runs 200 --trace-kernel-select
```

sumi: quick notes from looking at logs: several requests hit KV capacity watermark at the same time, eviction kicks in which forces memcpy off-GPU -> stalls. Also kernel selector heuristics use average seq len, so mixed workloads can flip choices mid-rollout.

navid: idea: add guard that avoids switching kernels on the hot path unless aggregated expected win > threshold (latency-weighted). Also consider per-worker sticky kernel hint per model-version for X minutes.

maria: what about RoPE scaling? any interaction?

devon: observed minor improvement when forcing rope_scale=0.75 for long seqs, likely reduced numerical magnitude so fused_attn stayed stable; but this is model-sensitive. Not a general fix.

sumi: immediate mitigation plan:
- force fused_attn hint for mixtral-large on dedicated capacity while we triage
- raise KV eviction watermark by +20% for that pool to reduce simultaneous evicts
- add additional logging to kernel_selector to record reason codes for switches
- run A/B with sticky kernel hints (5m) to see tail improvement

devon: I'll run the A/B now. Patch: https://git.redwood/srv/kernel-selector/changes/2345 (small guard + log).

perf-bot: A/B test scheduled: cohort A (= fused_attn hint + +20% kv watermark), cohort B (= current). Start 1773338000, expected runtime 2h.

maria: tx. If A wins, we can fold sticky hint into selector and add an explicit bypass when kv_eviction_rate > 0.03. Also add a perf regression alert for p95 increase > 15%.

devon: quick run (after forcing hint locally): p95 dropped from 220ms -> 160ms on same traces. Throughput same. Will push canary to dedicated pool in 10m.

navid: long-term: work items:
- make kernel selector cost model aware of eviction overhead (estimate memcpy cost based on kv occupancy)
- experiment with adaptive batch caps for long ctxs to reduce concurrency-induced eviction thrash
- validate rope_scale per-model profiles + document safe ranges for Mixtral/Mistral/Llama/Qwen

sumi: agree. Also add a short eval to Optimize that flags models with high eviction sensitivity.

devon: will follow up with a short writeup once A/B finishes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
